name: visible-ssh-test-host
description: A real DSH web host, installed INSIDE this repo, for the browser-level check (test/own-host-check.mjs). Pinned to the same version the desktop host ships, so the check answers for the runtime that is actually in use. Built by test/tools/setup-env.mjs; it replaces a former scratch/env/dsh-latest, which had drifted to 0.1.7-rc.1.
